name: corridorkey-desktop
description: Free Linux desktop app for CorridorKey 2.0, Corridor Digital's AI green-screen keyer.

scripts.dist:linux: tools/build_engine.sh && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: tools/build_engine.sh --windows && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: tools/build_engine.sh --mac && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run gates && npm test && npm run test:engine
scripts.check:engine: cd engine-rs && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test

author: MarcelineVPQ
